verdict.rationale: bizfile California is an online portal for filing, searching, and ordering business records. A portal like this could plausibly offer AI-generated insights, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence describes any AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from user data; the documentation covers only filings, searches, copies, and User Access controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
